title: Succession
start: Speak to Adrasteia in the Falador castle throne room.

recommended.t: Activated Falador lodestone or Falador Teleport to travel to White Knights' Castle
Archaeology journal, Dig Site pendant, pontifex shadow ring or better to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, Varrock Dig Site, or Elder God Wars Dungeon
Wilderness sword or Carrallangar Teleport to reach Ruins (east) quickly
Slayer cape to teleport to Mandrith, activated Ardougne or Edgeville lodestone via Deserted Keep for the Mage Arena
Imperial district teleport, Leela's favour, or activated Menaphos lodestone to travel to Grand Library of Menaphos directly
Either activated Al Kharid lodestone or amulet of glory and coins to travel to the entrance of Menaphos via Shantay Pass
Activated Fort Forinthry lodestone to travel quickly to argonlike rocks.

kills.t: Several scaled, safe combat encounters where you cannot bring your own food or equipment.
Later in the quest, you will need to survive a journey into the depths of the threatening Wilderness.

rewards.t: Combat XP lamp (50,000 experience in chosen skill, limited to Attack, Strength, Defence, Constitution, Ranged, Magic, and Necromancy. Must have at least level 60 in the chosen skill. Reclaimable from Adrasteia if lost before gaining experience.)
Prismatic XP lamp (60,000 experience in a chosen skill. Must have at least level 60 in the chosen skill. Reclaimable from Adrasteia if lost before gaining experience.)
Tier 6 of the Infernal Puzzle Box becomes available, granting the ability to add Infernal Puzzle Box to the tool belt

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the throne room on the floor 2 of the White Knights' Castle. [Chat: Accept › 1 Yes. › 4 Let's continue our journey.]
Head to the Varrock Dig Site and enter ancient door leading to Senntisten. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: General Khazard and his followers attempting to move an item of significance

steps.t: Discover the large footprint downstairs. All discoverable entities in this quest should be marked by a red dot on your minimap. (1/5)
Go up the stairs.
Discover one of the bodies of demon cultists. (2/5)
Discover scratch marks. (3/5)
Discover ancient Zarosian architecture. (4/5)
Discover note from a worker in the western room along the southern part of the building where the wall is crumbled. (5/5)
(You must dismiss followers for the following steps. Talk to Adrasteia again to continue.)
Talk to one of the Khazard guards.
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests. [Chat: 1 Reset to starting position.]
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests again. [Chat: 1 Reset to starting position.]
Reset the puzzle with one of the long chests once more. [Chat: 2 Skip this puzzle (2 attempts). › 1 Yes, I'm ready to move on. › 4 Let's continue our journey.]
Head to Menaphos and enter the Grand Library. [Chat: 1 Succession. › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Adrasteia in the library. [Chat: 3 Farewell.]
Discover The Corruption on the first level from top, near the south-eastern corner. (1/3)
Discover The Secret Chamber opposite The Corruption, in the south-western corner. (2/3)
Discover The Living Dead on the bottom level, near the north-eastern corner. (3/3) [Chat: 1 Travel to the Magister's chamber (0/3).]
Discover the imbued bones on the western side of the chamber. (1/3)
Discover the fragments of an obelisk next to the soul obelisk. (2/3)
Touch the soul obelisk.
Climb the stairs.
Discover the magical residue. (3/3) [Chat: 1 Travel to the Soul Altar. (0/3).]
Discover the scorch marks. (1/3)
Discover the Soul Altar. (2/3)
Talk to Ka. (3/3)
You must dismiss followers and have no items for the following steps. Talk to Adrasteia again to continue or bank items.
Defeat the Magister. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm ready to move on. › 4 Let's continue our journey.]

sub.t: All prayers are disabled. Use abilities in order to win the fight.
If you die, you will be teleported to Menaphos gate. Enter the gate to return to the quest. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
If you fail to defeat him twice, there will be an option to skip the combat phase. [Chat: 2 Yes, and skip this combat encounter (2 attempts).]

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia in the throne room on the floor 2 of the White Knights' Castle. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 4 Never mind. › 1 Yes.]
Mine the argonlike rocks for 28 argonlike ore north-east of Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 4 Let's continue our journey]
Smelt at the furnace in the eastern ruins. [Chat: 4 Let's continue our journey]
Smith at the anvil in the building west of the Mage Arena.
Talk to Adrasteia.
Wear or wield all the needed items.
Talk to Adrasteia the Forgotten to the south-east up the stairs leading up to the Mage Arena. [Chat: 1 Yes, enter the Mage Arena.]
(You must have no additional items for the following steps. If you do, you can deposit them through the dialogue.)
Talk to Vengeance. [Chat: 3 I wait for orders. › 1 I chase after them. › 3 I refuse. › 1 I'm ready]
Defeat the 3 waves of enemies.

sub.t: You can use prayers. It is recommended to use magic protection prayers in waves 1, 2 and melee protection in wave 3.
After each enemy is defeated, restore your health with the health orbs.
If you fail a wave two times, the wave can be skipped to continue. [Chat: 2 Yes, and skip this combat encounter (2 attempts).]

steps.t: Discover the scuff marks. (1/4)
Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the north. (2/4)
Discover the scorch mark. (3/4)
Eavesdrop the defeated forgotten mage in the south. (4/4). Then talk to Adrasteia.
Talk to Kolodion.
Exit the Mage Arena. [Chat: 1 Yes, search the caves beneath the Mage Arena.]
p: The modified ritual marker beneath the Mage Arena

steps.t: Inspect the modified ritual marker.
Take the rune pouch.
Search the rune pouch in your backpack.
Take the white dust and choose the option empty rune pouch.
Use the one measly fire rune on a sharp rock.
Talk to Adrasteia [Chat: 2 [Show an item in your backpack to Adrasteia.]] and choose the option inert fire rune fragments.
Use the pouch of white dust on the sparkling pool to the south.
Sabotage the modified ritual marker and choose the option volatile fire rune fragments.
Conceal the blatantly sabotaged ritual marker and choose the option soggy pouch of grey paste.
Step into the sparkling pool. [Chat: 1 Exit the cave and return to the deep Wilderness. › 3 [Say nothing]]
Talk to Adrasteia. [Chat: 2 I have the seating plan › 1 The Asgarnian Ambassador › 3 The Kandarian Ambassador › 4 The Menaphite Ambassador › 2 The Misthalinian Ambassador › Any › 1 Yes]
(Cutscenes appear between the following steps. Clicking out of the dialogue after any of the cutscenes will cause you to rewatch the cutscenes. This will be a roughly 7 minute process.)
Kill 10 forgotten warriors.

sub.t: Use the abilities via the interface at the top of the screen. Make frequent use of the Blast ability (3) to kill multiple enemies around you.

p: Adrasteia speaking to the assembled crowd
Adrasteia speaking to the assembled crowd
Moia siphoning Zemouregal's energy, reverting him to his skeletal form

steps.t: Kill 20 more forgotten warriors.
Continue dialogue with Adrasteia.
Quest complete!
